title: Comparative study of mannose-containing polysaccharide nanogels for optimized M2 macrophage targeting and photoacoustic imaging
note: Nature Portfolio / Polymer Journal. Develops and compares mannose-containing IR-820 nanogels as targeted photoacoustic contrast agents; PMI nanogels yield the highest PA contrast for M2 macrophage imaging. Imaging is central to validation, although the primary novelty is contrast-agent/material design rather than imaging hardware or reconstruction.
